tools.description: esign-OP1. Issue a replacement agreement for a closed one, linked in both directions and recorded in the trail.

title.description: Optional title for the replacement; default '<source title> (replacement)'; truncated to 300 chars.

auth_method.description: Authentication for every created signer; default email_link.

idempotency_key.description: Client key for the run; a repeat returns the existing run.

name.description: Alias for full_name, used when full_name is empty.

source_document_id.description: Draft EsignDocument to copy (single-signer, has PDF and fields).

offset.description: Rows to skip (runs or recipients); default 0.

tools.name: endpoint.esign.bulk_send.status

access_code.description: access_code only: code to set (6-64 chars after removing whitespace, upper-cased); omit to have one generated. Ignored for email_link.

signer_id.description: EsignSigner id on a draft agreement.

tools.name: endpoint.esign.signer_auth
